goal: Allow official Linux release binaries to run across distributions without glibc or dynamic linker limits
Enables bitcoind to run directly on Alpine Linux, NixOS, and older Linux distributions
agreement: Broad support with successful testing across NixOS, Alpine, Ubuntu, Arch, and Fedora
Unaddressed objection: dynamic NSS resolvers break with mismatched host glibc libraries (luke-jr)
Supports static glibc approach over musl as more auditable and palatable (theuni)
Suggests hardcoding expected static binaries instead of dynamically detecting them (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because release binaries become portable to Alpine Linux, NixOS, and older glibc systems
Removes the need for custom LD_PRELOAD shims or external compatibility loaders on non-standard setups
